questions.question: After Joshua died, the Israelites asked the LORD who should go up first against the Canaanites. Which tribe did He choose?
Adoni-bezek had cut off the thumbs and big toes of seventy kings. When Judah captured him, what did he say?

answers.text: God had repaid him for it
His own men had turned on him
His luck had finally run out

questions.question: Caleb promised a reward to the man who captured the city of Kiriath-sepher. What was the reward?
Judah took the hill country but could not drive out the people living on the plains. Why not?

answers.text: Judah had run out of men
